issue_request: FHIR-14281 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for STU3 PlanDefinition trigger restrictions. The accepted resolution was to define invariants requiring the element appropriate for each TriggerDefinition.type: named-event requires a name, periodic-event requires timing, and data-event requires data, without adding new type-specific prohibitions.
initial_application: Jira records application at 07099b4. Git commit 07099b45f9 added the required-type-elements invariant to source/datatypes/triggerdefinition.xml; the separate data-versus-timing invariant predates the seed application.
additional_context: TriggerDefinition is active in source/fhir.ini and PlanDefinition.action.trigger is typed as TriggerDefinition. Later FHIR-21232 added coded named events and subscription-topic support, while FHIR-53414 clarified condition guidance and the XPath/FHIRPath invariant; those later issues are already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/datatypes/triggerdefinition.xml requires name or code for named-event, timing for periodic, data for data-* events, and subscriptionTopic for subscription-topic, and it no longer restricts condition to data triggers. Relaxing the still-existing data-versus-timing invariant would be broader than this published issue safely supports.
